usedFor: Productive.io holds projects, deals and invoices, Google Drive holds files, and “New deal” can start “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New deal” in Productive.io, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new deal shares a file by link at the Viewer, Commenter or Editor level you pick.

watchOut: “Updated Project” in Productive.io fires on every update, so “Share File With Anyone” can run again for the same project.
